note: Animal Crossing (GameCube, GAFE01_00) matched functions, compiled with CodeWarrior GC/1.3.2 at each unit's own flags (foresta.rel game code -O4,s -sdata 0 -sdata2 0; DOL game code -O4,s -sdata 0 -sdata2 0 -inline on). mwcceppc itself preprocesses the project's headers. Units include different headers, so `headers` is empty and each row's prependC carries its unit's own #include lines, then what the function needs from the rest of its unit: types, enums, macros and sized static data copied verbatim, and a static callee or an initialised datum declared. initial_menu.c's data preamble is copied whole, because step0_make_dl addresses its string literals from the start of the unit's .data.
